name: billing
title: Billing (Stripe)
description: Stripe subscriptions: pricing page, checkout, customer portal, webhooks and plan gating

env.description: Stripe secret key — https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys (billing stays disabled until set)
Webhook signing secret. Locally: `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/billing/webhook`
Stripe Price ids for each paid plan/interval (see src/modules/billing/plans.ts)
Free trial length for new subscriptions (0 = no trial)

notes: Edit plan names, prices and features in apps/api/src/modules/billing/plans.ts.
Create matching Products/Prices in Stripe and put the price ids in apps/api/.env.
Enable the Customer Portal in Stripe (Settings → Billing → Customer portal).
